OPTIONAL ADAPTIVE NOISE CANCELLATION BRANCH -- NOT IMPLEMENTED
Needs a second, reference microphone. Scoped as future work; the shipped system is single-microphone.
REAL-TIME SPEECH ENHANCEMENT (ONLINE RUNTIME, ONE 16 ms FRAME AT A TIME)
Pure streaming: no look-ahead and no buffering beyond a single frame. Measured 83.6 ms end-to-end, mic to ear.

Why the processing runs on the edge
83.6 ms measured end-to-end with a chirp and cross-correlation, not estimated. ITU-T G.114 treats anything under 150
ms as transparent to a talker.
a field radio cannot assume a network link, and a cloud round trip would exhaust the latency budget on its own.
operational audio never leaves the device.
the model uses under a tenth of the time budget it is given, which leaves headroom for a slower board.
48,245 parameters, 562 KB. Small enough that ONNX Runtime threading buys nothing: 0.72 / 0.75 / 0.78 ms for 1 / 2 / 4
the Pi 5 has no 3.5 mm jack

need a reboot and can leave a board unbootable
The Band 2 runtime executes entirely on this device. No cloud and no network dependency at inference time.
Every figure quoted here is measured on this build. Grey dashed elements are declared future work and are not part of the current system.
